name: solenoid_shielded_lossless
notes: Replica of the 2022 COMSOL model Model_File.mph (arXiv:2211.00008, shielded lossless solenoid): closed annular PEC can R 0.5-1.0 m, z 0-1.5 m, 25 mm walls (revolved 360 deg, not meshed: mesh.remove_pec); a 1 cm annular slot R 0.745-0.755 through the 25 mm top lid; PEC bridge on the outer lid face z = 1.5 at phi = 0, R 0.740-0.760, |y| <= 0.5 mm (COMSOL: zero thickness; here 0.2 mm, z 1.5-1.5002); lumped port R 0.7500-0.7505 inside the bridge (current along +x); source Je = (0,0,1) A/m^2 in the bore R < 0.5, z 0-1.5 (fullwave.source kind axial_box, B0_T = 1 <-> Je = 1 A/m^2); closed PEC cylinder shield R 1.5 m, z -0.5..2.0 as the outer boundary (mesh.domain_solid, fullwave.rf_only). The 'bore' vacuum region only aligns element faces with the source discontinuity; the 'slot' vacuum region carves the slot and refines its walls. Lossless (vacuum only). Approach and lessons from toroid_small_shield_lossless.json: AXF_FW_SOLVER=strumpack, no tree-cotree gauge at order 2.
